question: Who among the following Indian actresses joined the list of Young Global Leaders (YGL) compiled by the World Economic Forum in March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepika Padukone**__.**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Actor** Deepika Padukone** has joined the list of the **Young Global Leaders** (YGLs) compiled by the W**orld Economic Forum**.
 
• The list also includes several **Indian citizens** and** India-origin person**s.
 
• **Deepika Padukone** is an internationally acclaimed **actor, fashion **and **youth icon**, and **mental health ambassador** from **India.**
 
• **Deepika **features in listings of the nation's most popular personalities, and Time named her one of the **100 most influential people** in the** world **in **2018.**
 
• **Padukone** is the founder of the** Live Love Laugh Foundation,** which creates awareness on **mental health in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 **Shilpa Shetty**
 
 
 
• Shilpa Shetty is an Indian actress, film producer, dancer, author, businesswoman, and former model who predominantly appeared in Hindi-language films.
 
• Shetty made her screen debut in the thriller Baazigar which garnered her two Filmfare Awards nominations.
 
 
 
 

 **Aishwarya Rai**
 
 
 
• Aishwarya Rai Bachchan is an Indian actress and the winner of the Miss World 1994 pageant.
 
• Aishwarya rai was honoured with Padma Shri in 2009.
 
• She achieved wider success and won two Filmfare Awards for Best Actress for her performances in Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam (1999) and Devdas (2002).
 
 
 
 

 **Alia Bhatt**
 
 
 
• Alia Bhatt is an actress and singer of Indian origin and British citizenship, who works in Hindi films.
 
• She has appeared in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2014 and was featured by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list of 2017.
 
• Alia Bhatt is the founder of the ecological initiative CoExist.
